evidence_items.explanation: Reuters reported TD Cowen's cancellation findings and a possible oversupply explanation. It also reported an alternative: Microsoft may have secured more prospective capacity than needed while responding to earlier shortages; neither explanation was established as the cause.

The latest quarterly disclosure reported rapid growth in Microsoft's AI business, which weighs against a literal no-growth reading. It is an annualized company metric from the preceding quarter, not realized annual revenue or proof of industrywide demand sufficient for every planned project.
